label: the table scrolls vertically, so a wide table is clipped instead of readable (R-rn-table-block)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/TableBlock.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R4: the table scrolls horizontally inside its own row"

label: a header cell is an ordinary cell, so the first row is not announced as the header (R-rn-table-block)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/TableBlock.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R4: every header cell is exposed as a header and every body cell reads its own text"

label: a cell is allowed to shrink, so the table squeezes to the phone measure instead of scrolling (R-rn-table-block)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/TableBlock.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R4: the table scrolls horizontally inside its own row"
